claims.text: Jamaica Inn sits on an eight-acre property with a secluded beach.

findings.quote: peaceful, eight-acre retreat. Be enticed by the warm champagne sands of our secluded beach

claims.text: The beach is a 700-foot stretch of golden shore.

findings.quote: A 700-foot swathe of warm golden shore awaits.

claims.text: The British colonial-style inn has no TVs or radios.

findings.quote: The British colonial-style inn has no TVs or radios but does promise sea views.

claims.text: The hotel's look features white columns and blue arches.

findings.quote: with an easy island glamour done in white columns and blue arches

claims.text: The Morrow family has run the hotel since 1958.

findings.quote: Since 1958, the Morrow family have lovingly run this iconic island hotel.

claims.text: All stays include resort amenities, continental breakfast, afternoon tea and evening hors d'oeuvres.

findings.quote: All stays include complimentary resort amenities, continental breakfast, afternoon tea, and evening hors d

claims.text: The one-bedroom cottages each have an elegant living and bar space, an infinity plunge pool, ocean views and private sea access.

findings.quote: each with an elegant living and bar space, infinity plunge pool, sweeping ocean views and private sea access

claims.text: The Cowdray Suite is a large first-floor suite with a separate dressing room, a large balcony veranda and sunset views of the sea and mountains.

findings.quote: An especially large, first-floor suite with a separate dressing room, large balcony veranda and romantic sunset views of the sea and mountains.

claims.text: The Beach Wing suites have antique furniture and fresh flowers inside.

findings.quote: Expect gorgeous antique furniture and fresh flowers inside.

claims.text: The hotel is a member of the White River Foundation and takes part in a coral restoration programme.

findings.quote: As proud members of the White River Foundation, we protect the waters around Jamaica Inn, and are part of a coral restoration programme

claims.text: Every Saturday the hotel offers complimentary croquet tuition with a glass of rose.

findings.quote: Every Saturday at 3pm we offer complimentary croquet tuition with a chilled glass of rosé

claims.text: The Terrace restaurant serves an ever-changing menu of island ingredients with live music each evening.

findings.quote: The Terrace comes alive every evening with an everchanging menu showcasing the freshest island ingredients, and live music to set the tone.

claims.text: Suite 21, the largest suite, sits on a secluded peninsula with its own private grounds, an oceanfront sundeck and a plunge pool.

findings.quote: Our largest suite can be found on a secluded peninsula with its own private grounds, huge oceanfront sundeck and a plunge pool.

claims.text: The hotel's crescent-shaped secluded beach is a stretch of golden sand.

findings.quote: Our crescent-shaped secluded beach is the blissful base for your day
A 700-foot swathe of warm golden shore awaits.

claims.text: The cottages have Indonesian-style interiors, private plunge pools and secluded outdoor showers.

findings.quote: Cottages add Indonesian-style interiors, private plunge pools, and secluded outdoor showers to the mix.

claims.text: The Ocean Spa is an oceanfront spa with a saltwater sea bath.

findings.quote: ### The Ocean Spa
Our tranquil oceanfront spa harnesses the healing power of nature
a soak in the blissful saltwater sea bath!

claims.text: The hotel has had resident black Labradors since the 1970s, and Shadow V has her own cottage on the property.

findings.quote: The hotel is famous for several black Labradors who have been part of the Inn over the years, dating back to the 1970s.
Shadow V is our resident canine and even has her own cottage on property, too.

claims.text: Jamaica Inn is about an hour and a half from the airports in Montego Bay and Kingston.

findings.quote: Jamaica Inn is located approximately an hour and a half from both Donald Sangster International Airport in Montego Bay (MBJ) and Norman Manley International Airport in Kingston (KIN).

claims.text: The fitness centre is small.

findings.quote: our small but well-equipped fitness centre

claims.text: WhataHotel notes limited modern amenities and technology.
